rows.text: Independent inspection review found save/validation races, foreign-component property leakage, missing native validators and lost return-navigation controls. Corrected in a857cbd; exact regression recordings and focused engine/browser suites pass.

Further review found owner-restricted properties editable, type inspection using editing restrictions, and cross-form errors disappearing. Kept owner restrictions in the editing overlay, restored authoritative declarations and rendered diagnostics unless an actual connector replaces them; before/after recordings pass.

Shutdown review required draining every accepted response before closing sockets. Added a per-socket counter before request handlers; 3 lifecycle cases and 3 repeated browser shutdown cases pass. Fixture review preserves relations, real Waiting prerequisites and nested annotation contexts. Full rerun remains in progress.
